186:Testing
187--------
188-
189:``networkx`` has an extensive test suite that ensures correct
190:execution on your system.  The test suite has to pass before a pull
191:request can be merged, and tests should be added to cover any
192-modifications to the code base.
193-
194:We make use of the `pytest <https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/>`__
195:testing framework, with tests located in the various
196:``networkx/submodule/tests`` folders.
197-
198:To use ``pytest``, ensure that the library is installed in development mode::
199-
200-    $ pip install -e .
201-
202:Now, run all tests using::
203-
204:    $ PYTHONPATH=. pytest networkx
205-
206:Or the tests for a specific submodule::
207-
208:    $ PYTHONPATH=. pytest networkx/readwrite
209-
210:Or tests from a specific file::
211-
212:    $ PYTHONPATH=. pytest networkx/readwrite/tests/test_yaml.py
213-
214:Or a single test within that file::
215-
216:    $ PYTHONPATH=. pytest networkx/readwrite/tests/test_yaml.py::TestYaml::testUndirected
217-
218:Use ``--doctest-modules`` to run doctests.
219:For example, run all tests and all doctests using::
220-
221:    $ PYTHONPATH=. pytest --doctest-modules networkx
222-
223:Test coverage
224--------------
225-
226:Tests for a module should ideally cover all code in that module,
227-i.e., statement coverage should be at 100%.
228-
229:To measure the test coverage, install
230:`pytest-cov <https://pytest-cov.readthedocs.io/en/latest/>`__
231:(using ``pip install pytest-cov``) and then run::
232-
233:  $ PYTHONPATH=. pytest --cov=networkx networkx
